newsitem.title: USA: Vinik hedge fund up and investing.
newsitem.headline: Vinik hedge fund up and investing.

text.p: Former Fidelity Investments' star fund manager Jeffrey Vinik will begin investing $800 million from his new hedge fund on Friday, according to sources in the investment community.
Vinik's strong track record as head of the Magellan Fund helped him raise funds at a startling pace, making Vinik Asset Management one of the 20 largest hedge funds in the world.

"With a marquee name like Vinik's, it obviously is easy to raise money," said George Van of Van Hedge Fund Advisors, a Nashville, Tenn. firm. "It obviously is very unusual for anybody in a hedge fund to raise this much money this quickly."
Around half of the funds were raised in Europe, and international financier George Soros also invested some of his more than $15 billion in holdings with Vinik, the sources said.

Vinik's hedge fund specialises in managing money for wealthy and institutional clients, and requires a minimum investment of at least $2 million, they said. The fund was limited to around 100 investors and is closed to further participants, they said.
Vinik Asset Management Chief Operating Officer Mark Hostetter declined to comment on the rumours. Officials for Soros also declined to comment.
Vinik racked up big gains as head of the $55 billion Magellan Fund during his first three years.

But in 1996, he shifted his investments out of technology stocks and into bonds, just as interest rates began rising. The move caused Magellan's returns to plummet and, amid vocal criticisms, Vinik suddenly left Fidelity in late May.
When he announced his departure, Magellan had returned just 3.7 percent from the beginning of the year compared with 9.3 pecent for the Standard & Poor's 500.
Vinik, who joined forces with former Fidelity fund managers Marc Kaufman and Michael Gordon, set up shop in downtown Boston.
The hedge fund will give Vinik wider latitude to make investments than a mutual fund, which could lead to more lucrative returns, hedge fund watchers said.
